title: TensorPlate Safe-State Event
description: Discrete safe-state event emitted by `tensorplate-observability` (V01-E10-F04) on transitions into degraded / failed / no-heartbeat states and, optionally, on a configured periodic interval. Consumers (V01-E11 status / log views, release validation harness, future safe-state actuators) MUST NOT assume the producer is alive between emissions; the event captures the full diagnostic context required to decide next steps without a follow-up query.

state.description: Aggregated observability state at the time the event was emitted.

reason.description: Discrete reason for the event. Consumers filter without parsing free-text messages.

monotonic_age_ms.description: Monotonic milliseconds since the most recent transition the aggregator observed.
